detailed_descriptions.en: When Maria, a globe-trotting antique restorer, arrives in the sun-soaked town of Bellariva, she has no idea just how broken it will turn out to be. She wants nothing more than to help the town’s inhabitants save their most beloved possessions, but when it’s their personal lives that are starting to fracture, she’ll need to find a way to hold them together, one spare screw at a time. Figure out the inner workings of the objects brought to Maria and find a way to fix them. Meet the townsfolk of Bellariva. Come to love their quirks and help them reconnect. Rediscover the defining objects of decades past to the tune of the original soundtrack, inspired by the sounds of the 80s.
